title: Two-photon blockade without cascade channel in strong light-matter coupling
summary: We report a distinct two-photon blockade (termed as weak TPB) discovered in the strong-coupling regime of a parity-broken generalized quantum Rabi model, in addition to the other two-photon blockade (termed as strong TPB) in the ultrastrong coupling (USC) regime. In contrast to the strong TPB conventionally with opened cascade decay channel, the weak TPB phase emerges unconventionally with closed cascade decay channel.
